observations: Photo shows a beige/cream upholstered sofa/bench-style seat with tufted/stitched sections and rolled/rounded armrest ends.
No visible brand label, model tag, or clear size reference in the photo.
Upholstery appears intact in the visible areas; no obvious tears or major stains are clearly visible from this single angle.
A watermark text is visible on the image, but it does not identify the item.

claims.evidence: No photo evidence of age/usage duration (no receipts, tags, or wear indicators that can be reliably dated).
No measuring tape/ruler or known reference in the photo to confirm length.

risks.risk: Exact size/length is unknown; seller’s 'over 4 feet' may be inaccurate, affecting value and fit in the buyer’s space.
risks.proof: A photo with a measuring tape laid along the full length (arm to arm) and another photo showing width/depth.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a smaller/uncertain length upholstered seat (worst-case for fit/value).

risks.risk: Condition details not visible: hidden stains, odor, sagging cushions, or damage on the underside/back.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seams, underside, back panel, and cushion bottoms; plus a quick video showing cushion bounce/sag.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as used with possible wear (worst-case: not fully clean/possible minor defects).

risks.risk: Comfort/structure integrity (frame and springs) cannot be confirmed from one angle.
risks.proof: Video of someone sitting/standing up from the seat to show bounce and stability; ask for whether it is firm or sagging.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially needing reconditioning (worst-case: reduced firmness).

risks.risk: Material type (leather vs fabric/PU) and whether it’s easy to clean is unclear from the photo.
risks.proof: A close-up of the upholstery surface and a photo of the back/side showing material texture; ask if it’s leather, PU, or fabric.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic upholstered fabric/unknown material (worst-case for resale/maintenance).

proof_requests: Photo with measuring tape showing full length (arm to arm) and height.
Close-up photos of seams, corners, and any buttons/tufts (front and sides).
Photos of the back and underside (or a short video) to check hidden damage/stains.
Video showing cushion firmness (sit test) and whether it sags.
response.reason: From the photo, the item appears to be an upholstered sofa/bench seat, but the key pricing drivers (exact length, true material, and structural/cleanliness condition) are not verifiable with the current single image and unconfirmed seller claims.
